summary: Branch claude/hopeful-cray-ejxi9m is merge-ready. All app gates pass: typecheck clean, lint 0 warnings, 688/688 tests (31 new duel HUD tests). Pack hygiene clean (8 files, 0 violations). Working tree clean, branch pushed and in sync with origin. Orchestrator typecheck and test fail but are pre-existing on main (identical errors: missing @types/node, @cursor/sdk, tsx not installed) and unrelated to this change which touches only app/ files.
goal: Verify quality gates, confirm branch is clean and merge-ready for duel HUD unification

exitCriteria.orchestrator_typecheck: FAIL (pre-existing on main, not introduced by this change)
exitCriteria.orchestrator_test: FAIL (pre-existing on main, tsx not installed)

learnings.insight: Orchestrator typecheck and test gates fail identically on main and this branch. The orchestrator job in CI will fail, and since the CI aggregator job requires both test and orchestrator to succeed, PRs will show red CI even for pure app/ changes. This is a pre-existing issue, not introduced by the duel HUD unification.
learnings.action: Fix orchestrator dev dependencies (@types/node, tsx, @cursor/sdk) as a separate maintenance task to unblock CI for all PRs.

learnings.insight: The app/ quality gates (typecheck, lint, test) are the reliable local gates for app/ changes. The orchestrator gates require dependency installation that is not present in this environment but may work in CI with yarn install --frozen-lockfile.
learnings.action: When integrating app-only changes, the three app gates plus pack-hygiene are sufficient for local verification. CI will validate orchestrator independently.

learnings.insight: Duel HUD unification: 688/688 tests pass with 31 new tests. The change is a pure client-side UI refactor with 3 production files changed (DuelRoom.tsx, ExpeditionHud.tsx, expedition.css) and 1 new test file. No new dependencies, no API surface changes, no security concerns.
